reason: The libsvm linear C=10 fit was incomplete after 517.5 seconds. A dedicated linear solver offers a practical dense high-dimensional baseline; all four measured pilots remain in the log.
main_study: 24 configurations numbered svm-search-024 through svm-search-047. Same train-only StandardScaler, feature modes, C values, class weights and validation F2 selection. Linear candidates use LinearSVC squared hinge, dual=auto, tol=1e-4, max_iter=10000. Nonlinear candidates remain SVC RBF gamma=scale. Intercept regularisation and squared hinge differ from the pilots and are reported, not treated as identical fits.
retention: Pilot records and checkpoints remain genuine evidence. The interrupted fit is engineering evidence and is not counted among four substantive scientific failures.
